title: 8.1 Similar Polygons

icans: I can write a similarity statement, the congruent angles, and a statement of proportionality for similar polygons.
I can use a scale factor to find a missing side length in similar polygons.
I can find the perimeter and area of a polygon from a similar polygon.

vocab: same shape, not necessarily the same size: ________________ angles are congruent and corresponding side lengths are proportional
the ratio of ________________ side lengths (image : original)
an equation showing the ratios of all pairs of ________________ sides are equal
parts in the same position, matched by the order of the letters in the _____________ statement

blocks.p: On graph paper, draw right △ABC with legs 3 and 4 (the hypotenuse is 5). Draw it again with every side 2 times as long, then 3 times as long. Check the angles with a protractor.
What happened to the angles? What happened to the perimeter? To the area?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Similar polygons: Two polygons are similar when corresponding angles are _______________ and corresponding side lengths are _______________.
Scale factor: The ratio of corresponding side lengths is the _______________ _______________.
Corresponding parts: If △ABC ~ △DEF, then ∠A ≅ ∠____, and AB corresponds to ______.

blocks.stem: △ABC ~ △DEF. Find the scale factor from △ABC to △DEF. List the pairs of congruent angles and write a statement of proportionality.
△JKL ~ △MNP. JK = 8, KL = 10, MN = 12, and NP = 3x − 6. Find x. If m∠K = 52°, what is m∠N?

notes: Perimeters of similar polygons: if the scale factor is k, the ratio of the perimeters is _______________.

blocks.stem: △ABC ~ △DEF. AB = 9 and DE = 15. The perimeter of △ABC is 36. Find the perimeter of △DEF.

notes: Areas of similar polygons: if the scale factor is k, the ratio of the areas is _______________.

blocks.stem: Two triangles are similar. Their areas are 50 cm² and 18 cm². A side of the larger triangle is 15 cm. Find the corresponding side of the smaller triangle.
△RST ~ △XYZ with RS = 12 and XY = 8. The altitude from T in △RST is 9. Find the altitude from Z in △XYZ.
△ABC ~ △DEF. AB = 10, BC = x + 3, DE = 4, and EF = 6. Find x.
Two similar pentagons have perimeters 20 in. and 30 in. The smaller pentagon has an area of 48 in.². Find the area of the larger pentagon.

tickets.stem: △PQR ~ △STU with PQ = 9 and ST = 6. Find the scale factor from △PQR to △STU.
ABCD ~ WXYZ with AB = 12, BC = 15, and WX = 8. Find XY.
Two similar triangles have a scale factor of 2 : 5. The smaller triangle has a perimeter of 18 and an area of 12. Find the perimeter and area of the larger triangle.
